text_block_list.text:
I caught sight of Narita Taishin by chance 
and was about to call out to her, when—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I don't have the time to deal 
with noisy people like Ticket or you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
When you chatter on loudly like you always 
do, my head feels like it's gonna split 
open...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Come any closer, and I'll kick you for 
real.
choice_data_list: Should we call off today's training?
Shall we call off today's training?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "No way! I'll be fine after a short rest—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, fine...! I'll go to the infirmary! 
Happy now?!

Wariness in her eyes like a wounded beast, 
Narita Taishin walked away.
